requirement: Build tracker rows 0.1, 0.2 and 0.3 of the Gravity Falls Chapter 1 test flight: create the Godot 4.x project with the locked display settings and a macOS export preset, establish the locked project folder layout with tests/ and tools/ excluded from the export, and stand up the res://tests/test_all.gd + harness.gd suite skeleton that every later row appends its check to.

seams: res://tests/test_all.gd is the single entry point for the whole suite. Later rows append checks to it; nothing introduces a second suite entry point or a test framework dependency.

res://tests/harness.gd holds the shared stub/assert scaffolding (the RuntimeHarness of Doc 00 §12) that later rows extend. Checks marked (scene) are entered from test_all.gd but run against res://tests/scene_harness.tscn; the skeleton must leave room for that split without building it yet.
Doc 01 §10's directory tree is the single authority for every res:// path in the project. Any new file goes where the §10 placement rule says, and no file lives outside the tree.
architecture.note: No architecture pre-pass was run. Docs 00-06 already lock the stack, the folder layout, the display settings and the test entry point, so there is no open design fork for these three rows to settle.

tasks.title: Create the Godot 4.x project file with the locked display settings
tasks.intent: Stand up res://project.godot as a Godot 4.x project named for the game, with the canvas and stretch settings that Doc 01 §0 locks: 1920x1080 viewport, stretch_mode = canvas_items, stretch_aspect = keep. These three values are load-bearing for Doc 03's CELL grid and Doc 04's absolute pixel HUD layout, so they are set once here and never restated elsewhere.
tasks.constraints: Godot 4.x config_version. Set display/window/size/viewport_width = 1920, viewport_height = 1080, display/window/stretch/mode = "canvas_items", display/window/stretch/aspect = "keep". Do not register any autoload yet; autoloads land in rows 0.4 onward. Do not set a main scene; no scene exists yet. Do not add rendering, physics or input overrides that the docs have not asked for.
tasks.acceptance: project.godot exists at the repo root, Godot loads the project headlessly without error, and ProjectSettings reports viewport 1920x1080, stretch mode canvas_items, stretch aspect keep.
tasks.visual: The letterboxing observation in the tracker's Verify column ('true 16:9 on a 16:10 panel') cannot be made until a scene exists to render. The programmatic half of the gate — the three ProjectSettings values — is asserted in T3's suite. The visual half is carried to tracker row 1.1, when the first scene is built.
tasks.result: project.godot created at the repo root; Godot 4.7.1 imports it clean and ProjectSettings reads back 1920 / 1080 / canvas_items / keep.

tasks.title: Establish the locked folder layout and the export filter
tasks.intent: Adopt Doc 01 §10's directory tree as the project's layout and make the export exclude tests/ and tools/ from day one, per the tracker row's Notes. Doc 01 §10 also states 'Create no folder before its first file' — an empty directory is speculative scaffolding — so this task creates only the directories that have a file landing in them now, and records the full tree as the authority that T3's structure check enforces.
tasks.constraints: Do NOT mkdir the full 40-directory tree; Doc 01 §10 forbids creating a folder before its first file. Create only tests/ (T3 fills it); tools/ waits for Doc 05 §7.1's bake_placeholders.gd at tracker row 3.1. Add a macOS export preset to export_presets.cfg with exclude_filter covering tests/ and tools/. Do not invent directories the docs do not name, and do not rename anything in the §10 tree.
tasks.acceptance: export_presets.cfg carries a macOS preset whose exclude_filter excludes tests/ and tools/; the preset is tracked in git; no directory exists that Doc 01 §10 does not name.
tasks.result: macOS export preset added with exclude_filter 'tests/*, tools/*'; .gitignore amended to stop ignoring export_presets.cfg, since the filter is a tracked deliverable; no speculative directories created. Enforced by T3's structure walk.
tasks.deviation: Doc 01 §10 draws tools/ OUTSIDE res://, which is only literally achievable if the Godot project root is a subdirectory of the repo. That would break the tracker's stated one test command ('godot --headless --script res://tests/test_all.gd', no --path). Repo root is therefore the project root, tools/ sits inside res://, and the export preset's exclude_filter is what enforces §10's actual requirement — never shipped, never run at boot. Flagged rather than swapped silently.

tasks.title: Stand up the test_all.gd suite skeleton and harness
tasks.intent: Create res://tests/test_all.gd (a SceneTree script, the single entry point for every check in the project) and res://tests/harness.gd (the shared assertion and future-stub scaffolding). The skeleton must run green today and be the place every later tracker row appends its check. It carries the first real checks: T1's three ProjectSettings values, and the Doc 01 §10 structure walk that is tracker row 0.2's Verify column.
tasks.constraints: test_all.gd extends SceneTree with a _init() that runs the checks, prints a pass line, and calls quit() with exit code 0 on success and a nonzero code on failure — the command 'godot --headless --script res://tests/test_all.gd' must exit 0 when green and nonzero when a check fails. Do not add a test framework dependency (no GUT, no gdUnit); Doc 00 §12's suite is plain asserts. Note that Godot's release builds strip assert(), so failures must be reported through an explicit check helper in harness.gd that records and returns a failure rather than relying on assert() alone. Leave a clearly marked seam for the (scene) checks that later rows will run from res://tests/scene_harness.tscn, but do NOT build scene_harness.tscn now — no row needs it yet. Keep the structure walk data-driven from a single list of the Doc 01 §10 allowed paths, so a later row amends one list rather than editing walk logic.
tasks.acceptance: 'godot --headless --script res://tests/test_all.gd' exits 0 and prints a pass summary; the suite asserts viewport 1920x1080, stretch mode canvas_items and stretch aspect keep; the suite walks res:// and fails if any file or directory sits outside the Doc 01 §10 tree; deliberately breaking a checked value makes the command exit nonzero.
tasks.result: tests/test_all.gd (SceneTree entry point) + tests/harness.gd (expect/expect_eq bookkeeping, no bare assert() so release builds cannot silently pass). 5 checks green, exit 0; a planted stray root file drove it to 'test_all: 4 passed, 1 FAILED' and exit 1, so the gate bites in both directions.
